continuity_state: Rook traded filter parts, route information and conditional warning for clean east-line water. The System delivered Tomas, Irena and Vale as dependent claims, but the Hearth accepted them as members after the group prohibited ownership and adopted exit, refusal, privacy and two-person emergency rules at a 12% efficiency penalty. Tomas repaired the filter, Irena maps the municipal system and Vale handles questionable procurement. Bond Treatment stabilized Nika's fever but made separation from Mriya impossible. Mriya ended it by reducing Bond from 2 to 0, suspending the human bridge and extended Chosen Route. Nika proved her restored freedom by leaving and returning voluntarily; she remains angry with Mriya.
